mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, '휴가' AS leaveType, days, status FROM leave_request WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND end_date < CURRENT_DATE() ORDER BY end_date DESC

SELECT leave_request_id AS leaveRequestId, DATE_FORMAT(request_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS submittedDate, DATE_FORMAT(start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, '휴가' AS leaveType, days, status, reason AS remark FROM leave_request WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ORDER BY request_date DESC, leave_request_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_request ( emp_id, start_date, end_date, days, reason, status, request_date ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', NOW() )
